teachingText: When Blue first reaches the radio-sailing zone, Blue is clear ahead and Yellow has not reached the zone. Yellow must give Blue mark-room while rule 18 applies, even after Yellow later establishes an outside overlap.

provenance.title: Racing Rules of Sailing 2025-2028
